digest.component_or_area: docs/exit-codes.md and CLI exit code documentation
propositions: The exit-codes.md documentation is incomplete, covering only 41 of 75 real commands including omissions of review-plan, review-code, and verify-completion which are defined in the same document
Exit codes 75 (EXIT_RESCHEDULE), 78 (StoreIncompatibleError), 3, 4, and 12 are produced but not documented in the exit-codes table
The scope note claiming only five commands validate unknown options is stale; metrics, doctor, composer, and fsck all exit 2 on unknown options
No CI check currently enforces that every dispatcher arm has a corresponding exit-codes.md row, allowing new commands to be added without documentation
The document lacks a forward-compatibility statement defining how unknown non-zero exit codes must be interpreted
